title: UFOs shut down nuclear missiles

tellings.quote: I've I've interviewed a lot of those guys firsthand and I think they're all legit.

plain: US nuclear missiles are said to have been shut down while UFOs were seen at the missile sites. Michels says he has personally interviewed many of the men who tell these stories and believes they are all genuine, though here he does not name any of them or give dates. If true, it would mean something unknown was able to switch off America's nuclear weapons.
